gating_model.client_scope: The client patch is FIXED per flavor. Only world CONTENT is gated — never the binary, DBCs, maps, vmaps, mmaps, or the client's own UI (design §0). Default = the flavor's final patch, so existing worlds are unaffected.
gating_model.seed: One pinned seed per flavor (the flavor's final-patch state, protected by the sqlite-seed-baseline hash chain). Per-stage seeds are rejected; the stage delta is a reversible flag-set layer over the seeded datadir.
gating_model.mechanism: game_event active windows + availability flags: per-stage reversible overlay SQL (flag-set statements only, never DELETE) over the world DB, plus stage-marker game_event rows whose CONDITION_ACTIVE_GAME_EVENT conditions demote vendor/loot/quest/entry rows — every mechanism shares one activation story (design §2/§3). Applied at world start when the active stage differs from the applied one.
gating_model.status: v1 = the gating framework (stage registry, settings knobs, conf emission, era-policy linkage) with EMPTY measured id sets; curated per-stage sets land only with the measured DB pins (design §9.2), never before.
